text: The game crashes every time I try to load my save file. Lost twenty hours of progress and support never answered.
Matchmaking takes forever and when it finally finds a lobby the lag is unbearable. Rubber-banding all over the place.
Fifteen dollars for a single skin is ridiculous. The store is clearly designed to milk players.
The story starts strong but the last act feels rushed, like they ran out of time and cut half the plot.
Crashed three times during the final boss. Had to redo the whole fight each time.
Servers are unstable in the evenings; ping jumps to 300ms and the game becomes unplayable online.
Season pass prices keep going up while the content keeps shrinking. Feels predatory.
Characters are flat and the dialogue is cringe. I stopped caring about anyone halfway through.
After the latest patch the game freezes on the loading screen on my PC. Had to reinstall twice.
Ranked mode is ruined by lag spikes. Lost so many matches because inputs register a second late.
The battle pass gates the best rewards behind hundreds of hours or paying extra. Not okay.
Plot twists were predictable and the ending made no sense given everything before it.
I love this game, my favourite of the year!
Great soundtrack. Five stars.
Controls are clunky on controller and the menus are confusing, but the crashes are the real dealbreaker.
Loot boxes with paid keys in a full-price game should be illegal. Greedy monetization.
Constant disconnects from the server kick me out of matches; no reconnect option either.
The writing in the side quests is better than the main story, which is a mess of loose threads.
Memory leak makes the game stutter after an hour and eventually crash to desktop.
Microtransactions everywhere, even in single-player. Prices in the shop are absurd.
Netcode is terrible; hits that clearly landed don't count because of the latency.
Pacing in chapter three drags with endless fetch quests that add nothing to the story.
Bought it for my nephew, he seems happy with it.
Graphics are beautiful but performance tanks in big fights and then the game crashes.
